content.short: unsigned_algorithms (unsigs) is a unique on-chain generative art project with code stored on Cardano.
content.description: unsigned_algorithms, commonly known as 'unsigs,' is a pioneering generative art project on the Cardano blockchain that prioritizes technical and artistic permanence. Unlike traditional NFTs that point to external images, each unsig is stored entirely on-chain, with the metadata containing the actual code required to regenerate the artwork. This collection of 31,119 unique pieces challenges the standard NFT format, using the blockchain as a host for the art itself. Created by Alexander Watanabe, the project is a landmark in the evolution of on-chain digital art and collector culture.
